basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old barbecue enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to pursue my passion for cooking and trying out new grill recipes during my free time. Huge fan of Kamado Joe grills! I also love watching sitcoms like 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and occasionally get sucked into TV show trivia. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, especially on weekends. I'm single and enjoy the active social scene in Austin.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for about 5 years. I'm mostly self-taught when it comes to grilling, having picked up tips from online forums and YouTube channels. My interest in sitcoms and pop culture trivia comes from years of watching TV and engaging with fan communities.
